fixes.explanation: Good thought, friend, but that's not the one. Peter says no prophecy of Scripture comes from "one’s own interpretation." (2 Peter 1:20) The teaching of elders is still a person's teaching, and the next verse says no such prophecy was ever "brought forth by the will of man," but "men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit." (2 Peter 1:21) So the source isn't any person at all, it's God by the Holy Spirit.
